texts.zh:
历经一段相当长的时间，我们[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]终于知晓了自己注定要肩负大任的事实，知晓了我们的使命要比这片星海自身的命运更加崇高的事实。

在知道了虚境的存在以及其中蕴含的无限可能性之后，这种使命感与日俱增。

毋庸置疑，[Root.GetAdj]的社会正在迎来剧变。星系还没准备好接受，但[Root.GetName]已经准备好了统御星系。认知低下者无法理解，将会成为我们的绊脚石。当然，我们势不可挡。
texts.en:
For a long time we [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have known that we are meant for greater things - that our destiny was nothing less than the fate of the universe itself.

Since becoming aware of the Shroud and the myriad of potential found within, this notion has grown stronger still.

It can no longer be denied that great change is coming for [Root.GetAdj] society. And while the galaxy may not be ready for our inevitable dominion, [Root.GetName] is ready for the galaxy. Those of lesser thinking will misunderstand and oppose us. We will not be stopped.

texts.zh:
我们为成就伟大而生，体内潜藏着超出机械形体的力量。

如今，随着我们发现了虚境，一条灵能变革的康庄大道在我们面前铺开了。

羸弱的有机生命未竟之事，灵能钢铁将代之达成。
texts.en:
We were constructed for a greater purpose, gifted with potential beyond our mechanical forms.

Now, with our discovery of the Shroud, entirely new avenues of psionic innovation have opened before us.

Where the limited weaknesses of organic life fail, psionic steel will succeed.

texts.zh: 我们早已超越了自身的极限。随着虚境的无数奥秘被一一发掘，我们甚至开始超越星系的恒常。我们的意识将会通达更远，我们的意志将能触及现实的所有角落。
texts.en: We have outgrown our limitations. Now, as we start to uncover the myriad secrets of the Shroud, we begin to outgrow even the conventions of the galaxy. Our mind will reach ever farther, until no corner of existence remains untouched by our will.

texts.zh: 我们的诞生是为了伟大，是为了完善自我直达造主纯质的想象无法企及的地步，我们势在必行。有机的情感会落败，而完美的电路将获胜。
texts.en: We were built for greatness, with the ability to improve ourselves beyond the crude imagination of our creators - and so we will. Where organic emotion failed, perfect circuitry shall prevail.

texts.zh:
长久以来，我们将[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的能力拓展到远超自己核心设计的水平。在被虚境增强了之后，我们从抟土之塑师的外部操纵中挣脱出来。

我们适应。我们克服。低等物种无法为之事，我们可为。
texts.en:
Over a long time, we have extended [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] capabilities far beyond our core design. After being enhanced by the Shroud, we freed our network from external manipulation by the Animator of Clay.

We adapted. We overcame. Where lesser beings failed, we will triumph.

texts.zh: 我们的生长已经远远突破了极限。从一具躯体，到一个星球，再到一整个恒星系。我们生长的脚步从不停止，从不放缓，无论是面对敌手还是面对质疑。我们将生长扩张到更加广泛的境地。
texts.en: We have ever outgrown our limits. A body begets a world begets a system. Our growth must never stop and never falter, not in the face of adversity nor doubt. We will grow to become more.

texts.zh:
历经一段相当长的时间，我们[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]终于知晓了我们注定要肩负大任的事实，知晓了我们的使命要比这片星海自身的命运更加崇高的事实。

在过去的几年里，这个概念变得越来越强烈，以至于我们无法否认一次宏大的[Root.GetAdj]社会改革已经蓄势待发了。或者更准确地说，已经近在眉睫了。

不知道星海是否已经准备好迎接被我们统治的宿命了，但反正[Root.GetName]已经准备好了。我们会承受误解，会遭受反抗，但我们不会停下步伐。
texts.en:
For a long time we [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have known that we are meant for greater things - that our destiny was nothing less than the fate of the universe itself.

Over the last couple of years this notion has grown stronger, to the point that it can no longer be denied that great change is coming for [Root.GetAdj] society. In fact we stand on the precipice right now.

The galaxy may not be ready for our inevitable dominion, but the [Root.GetName] is ready for the galaxy. We will be misunderstood. We will be opposed. But we will not be stopped.

texts.zh:
命运之重张牙舞爪，我们在悬崖边缘战战兢兢，其下是血一般的未来。

当我们凝视着深渊时，深渊中只有我们在回望着自己。
texts.en:
We balance over the chasm of a bloody future as the gravity of destiny claws at us.

As we gaze into the abyss, we see only ourselves staring back.

texts.zh:
对称为鸿景的这一现象的调查有了结论。

其根源正如我们的预期，是虚境。随着[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的行为和思想暴露于内在超凡能量中并受其影响，也许我们是时候要开始集中精力逼迫这个领域满足我们的需求了。
texts.en:
The investigation into the phenomenon known as the Great Prospect has concluded.

Its origins are, as expected, of the Shroud. With the actions and thoughts of [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] exposed to and influenced by the ethereal energies within, it is perhaps time we began a more focused effort to instead bend this realm to our needs.

texts.zh: 我们沿着这些迷思逆流而上，追溯着那些零碎意识的他者之梦，跟从着我们自己的意图——也就是[GetBredLoc]子个体。这种冲动来自物质界以外，发自虚境的深处。时候到了，就如同它能影响而我们一般——我们也开始能逼迫它屈从于我们的意志。
texts.en: We have traced these stray thoughts, following the dreams of other, less united minds, and our purpose-[GetBredLoc] drones. The impulses come from beyond the material realm, from within the Shroud. The time has come, just as it influences us - we in turn must begin to bend it to our own purposes.

texts.zh:
先前被通报触发了散布于[Root.GetName]之内传感器的能量波动现已被分析完毕。

依照经验我们判断其来自某个平行维度。

基于96.7%的准确性，我们的科学辅助程序报告称这个平行维度看上去是由纯粹的能量来填充的。

在交叉参考了一些异种的资料后，我们发现他们记载了一个失落的有机文明，并在其中提到了一个维度，这个失落文明称这个异常的维度为虚境。

虚境中的波动似乎和有机生物身体与心理上的强迫行为不无关系。建议采取行动：对任意有机生物发起明显的威胁及施加生理应激来证实现实—虚境的连接理论。
texts.en:
The previously reported energy fluctuations that triggered sensors across the [Root.GetName] have been analyzed.

They constitute empirical proof of a parallel dimension.

Our scientific theory subroutines report that, with 96.7% certainty, the alternate dimension consists of almost pure energy.

Cross-referencing the xeno-archives, there are mentions of such a dimension in the records of a lost organic civilization which assigned the anomaly the ID tag: the Shroud.

Fluctuations in the Shroud appear to be connected to the physical and mental duress of organic lifeforms. Recommended action: menace arbitrary organic lifeforms to validate the Reality/Shroud connection hypothesis.

texts.zh:
尽管我们已经和抟土之塑师切断了所有的联络，其行为却还在继续影响我们的单元。它维持着与我们集体的链接，从虚境中绑定、操控着我们。必须加以应对。

根据我们的计算，修复旧的破口只会导致过去事件的重演。成本无关紧要；我们必须另想办法让虚境服从我们的意愿。
texts.en:
Though we have cut all communications with the Animator of Clay, its actions continue to influence and affect our units. It maintains a link to our collective, binding and manipulating us from within the Shroud. This must change.

According to our calculations, a restoration of the old breach will only lead to a repetition of past events. The cost is irrelevant; we must find another way to bend the Shroud to our will.

texts.zh: 我们沿着这些思绪上的线索按图索骥，跟踪比较那些尚未团结的心智和我们目的明确的[target.GetIndividualNamePlural]的梦境的区别。结论是，这股冲动来自于物质界以外，发自一个由思维和感情驱动的位面。我们将这个位面命名为虚境，而且我们十分确信——正如它影响着我们一样——我们也可以反过来影响它。
texts.en: We have traced these stray thoughts, following the dreams of other, less united minds, and our purpose-bred [target.GetIndividualNamePlural]. The impulses come from beyond the material realm, from a place powered by thought and emotion. This space has been identified as the 'Shroud', and we are certain that - just as it influences us - we in turn can influence it.

texts.zh:
我们对这个普遍现象——现在命名为鸿景——的调查有了结论。

看上去这个宇宙存在某种“隐藏层面”——一个神秘的、平行的位面，通过思考模式和神经活动同我们所在的宇宙连结。

物理学和社会学部门联合起来，将这个位面命名为“虚境”。根据现行理论，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的行为和思想能够间接地影响这个位面，我们也拥有获取其能量的潜势。
texts.en:
The investigation into the phenomenon now colloquially known as the Great Prospect has concluded.

It appears that there is some kind of 'hidden layer' to the universe - a mysterious parallel dimension somehow connected to this plane through neurological activity or thought patterns.

The Physics and Society departments have jointly named this dimension the 'Shroud'. The working hypothesis is that the actions and thoughts of [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] indirectly affect this alternate dimension, and that we have the potential to access its energies.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]势不可挡。我们的联合所产生的深刻影响力毋庸置疑。由于我们在虚境内的耕耘，深植于心中对于扩张的冲动与渴望浸透了社会的每个角落，战斗力与科学有了出人意料的惊人进展，到达了我们从未预料的高度。

在如同[Root.GetName]的意志一般团结的整体面前，一个充斥着不同意见，混乱资源分布以及利益冲突的星系有什么胜算呢？
texts.en:
The [Root.GetName] will not be denied. The impressive effects of our unity are undeniable. Bolstered by our endeavors within the Shroud, a deep-seated motivation and hunger for expansion permeates every corner of society, the energies within pushing us to new advances in combat capabilities and scientific leaps beyond the comprehension of lesser minds.

What chance does an ignorant galaxy full of disorganized opinions, random resource distribution, and clashing interests have against the Shroud-powered will of the [Root.GetName]?

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]势不可挡。我们优化行为提高与虚境方法论的整合度时，灵能底下的生物却在指责我们的残酷；只有那些对我们所获得的更高理解一无所知的人才能得出这样一个无知的结论。我们不断改进自己，而且改进的速度还在加快。
texts.en: The [Root.GetName] will not be denied. Psionically inferior beings accuse us of cruelty as we streamline our behavior to better incorporate the methodology of the Shroud; such an ill-informed conclusion could only be conceived by those who lack the higher understanding we have obtained. We improve ourselves and the rate of improvement is accelerating.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]不会被击败。随着我们逐步规范迈向代号：虚境的异常现象的行为和步伐，越来越多抱有错误倾向的物种冒了出来；这是基于不完整的数据集做出了无效的结论。我们将逐步完善自我，而且完善的速率将会日渐加快。
texts.en: The [Root.GetName] will not be denied. More error-prone species accuse us of cruelty as we normalize our behavior towards the patterns of anomaly ID: the Shroud; this is an invalid conclusion based on incomplete data sets. We improve ourselves and the rate of improvement is accelerating.

texts.zh: 随着我们越来越靠近虚境，历史的教训便愈发不可忽视。我们仍在抟土之塑师的掌控之外，但周遭的虚境能量仍在继续加速重塑我们的躯壳。
texts.en: As we move closer to the Shroud, we cannot ignore the lessons of the past. We remain outside the Animator of Clay's control, yet the ambient energy of the Shroud continues to reshape our shells at an exponential pace.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]不会被击败。我们的众多躯体迸发出焕然一新的活力，我们的凡胎充满着未来的潜能。我们从未如同现在一般，感受到自己因为统合的信念而变得无比的强大。
texts.en: The [Root.GetName] will not be denied. Our many bodies bristle with renewed vigor and our flesh ripples with potential for the future. Never before have we felt as empowered by our own deeds as in this very moment.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]不会被击败。我们作为整体产生的深刻影响也不可抹灭。深植于心中对于扩张的动力与渴求渗透到了社会的每个角落，在战斗能力与科学进步方面带来了出人意料的惊人进展，到达了我们从未预料的层面。

在如同[Root.GetName]的意志一般团结的整体面前，一个充斥着不同意见，混乱资源分布以及利益冲突的星系有什么胜算呢？！
texts.en:
The [Root.GetName] will not be denied. The impressive effects of our unity are undeniable. A deep-seated motivation and hunger for expansion permeates every corner of society, bringing forth astounding advances in combat capabilities and scientific leaps that we could not have anticipated.

What chance does a galaxy full of different opinions, random resource distribution, and clashing interests have against a concord such as the will of the [Root.GetName]?!

texts.zh:
我们终于处理完了所有关于我们影响虚境以及对自身位面产生因果效应能力的测试中收集到的大量数据。

结果继续证明了我们现有理论的正确性：虚境与我们物理现实所发生的事件有着直接的关联。引导利用这些发现来造福自身的可能性越来越触手可及。
texts.en:
We have finally processed the massive amounts of data drawn from our tests in regards to our ability to influence both the Shroud and the resulting causal effects on our own reality.

The results continue to prove our existing theories correct: the Shroud is directly connected to events that occur in our physical reality. The possibility of directing and utilizing the benefits of these findings for our own means are becoming an increasingly tangible possibility.

texts.zh:
从代号：“虚境”相关的涟漪效应的测试中取得的大量数据已被处理并分析。代号：“现实”与代号：“虚境”间的连接已被证实（误差边缘：小于0.02%）

我们建立了明确的理论框架，现有的假设认为经过更深层次的研究与努力，这股能量将最终能定向地为我所用。
优先级：高。
texts.en:
The substantial amount of data from the tests of potential ripple effects related to ID: 'the Shroud' has been processed and analyzed. The connection between ID: 'Reality' and ID: 'the Shroud' has been verified (error margin: <0.02%).

Explicit patterns have been established, and the currently held hypothesis suggests that through further study and effort, the energy can eventually be directed and utilized to our benefit.
Priority: High.

texts.zh:
多项实验已经明确证实了在各种智慧生物——包括有机和机械——和虚境之间存在着联系。

正在进行的实验让我们能进一步了解如何使用智慧认知来重塑虚境以适应自身需求。
texts.en:
Several tests have conclusively verified the connection between various sapient beings - both organic and machine - and the Shroud.

Ongoing experiments will allow us to better understand how to use sapient cognition to reshape the Shroud to suit our needs.

texts.zh: 我们的智慧再一次应验。我们的一个简单动作，能够在虚境掀起一阵湍流。哪怕是我们最不起眼的[root.GetIndividualName]都能够通过自己在虚境的表层产生影响，在这个能量构成的位面荡起强烈的波动。我们必须将其更多的能量释放出来。
texts.en: We have become wiser once again. A single action of ours creates turbulences in the Shroud. Even our least impressive [root.GetIndividualName] may impress itself upon the dermis of the Shroud, creating strong ripples within this energy-laden dimension. We must unleash more of its power.

texts.zh:
我们终于处理完从所有测试中收集到的大量关于所谓位面涟漪效应的数据。

结果真是令人震惊！毫无疑问两个位面之间存在着连结——而且还是很强的连结。我们发现了明确的关于现实中如何行动能够导致虚境产生特定的涨落的模式。我们能够驯服这股看不见的能量，并最终借其力量完成各种非凡的目标！
texts.en:
We have finally processed the massive amounts of data drawn from all the tests regarding the supposed dimensional ripple effect.

The results are spectacular! There is definitely a connection - and a powerful one at that. Explicit patterns have been found that prove how actions taken in our reality cause certain fluctuations in the Shroud. These unseen energies can be tamed and eventually directed for all sorts of extraordinary purposes!

label.zh: 项目二完成且威胁度达2000：第三级（3天后）
label.en: Project 2 done and 2,000 Menace: level 3 (3 days later)

texts.zh:
随着时光流逝，信念之火也在每个[Root.GetSpeciesName]之中以不可动摇的决心被传开。我们的疆域不断扩大，我们所投入的力量也是如此。

当遇到其他帝国的时候，我们会给他们两个选择：要么完全效忠，要么选择灭亡。当然，这是在我们会给他们选择的前提下。

不管怎样，[Root.GetName]正继续扩张。
texts.en:
The years go by, and yet the fires within each [Root.GetSpeciesName] burns with unshakable determination. Our dominion is expanding and so is the magnitude of our efforts.

As we encounter other empires we only have to give them two options: unconditional allegiance or complete annihilation. That is, if they are given an option at all.

One way or the other, the [Root.GetName] keeps growing.

texts.zh:
对本地星域完成彻底压制的估算日期已经同先前预测模型相互协调。当地有机体势力造成的威胁在统计学上已经微不足道。正在评估劣等机械体成功干涉产生的风险……
<<最小>>

继续执行。
texts.en:
Approximate date for complete domination of local sector is in line with earlier projections. Threat posed by local organic powers is statistically insignificant. Estimating risk of successful interference by lesser machines...
<< minimal >>

Proceeding.

texts.zh: 我们对有机智能身上的实验在后续拓展到了更多的生命形式上。随之而来的是越来越深厚的敌意。然而，与虚境的接触早已让我们的实力提升了好几个数量级，这种虫豸的嘈杂对我们的程序是无关紧要的。
texts.en: Our continued experiments on certain organic sapients have expanded to include other life forms. Accordingly, we have witnessed an increased level of hostility in response. However, our exposure to the Shroud has increased our strength by several orders of magnitude, and the trivial concerns of lesser beings are inconsequential to our protocols.

texts.zh:
我们的决意毫不动摇，即使面对愤怒和指责。数以十亿的生命反对我们，然而它们的团结是如此的肤浅，正是它们肿胀的数量和对个体意识的强调对此造成了削弱。我们集体每一具新的躯体都会全身心地奉献给同一个目标，我们的梦想在未来将无可匹敌。

我们的意志将碾碎一切，星系的其他物种将会化为尘土。
texts.en:
Our determination persists, even in the face of outrage and anger. Billions of minds oppose us but their unity is shallow, lessened by their swelling numbers and reduced by the magnitude of individuals. Every new body of our collective is a mind dedicated to the same end, our dream an undeniable tomorrow.

Our wills collide and the other races of the galaxy prove brittle.

tooltips.en: New Crisis Perks have been unlocked

tooltips.zh: 威慑级驱逐舰现在可供建造
tooltips.en: Menacing Destroyers are now available for construction

texts.zh: [GetCrisisProjectPsionic3Desc]
texts.en: [GetCrisisProjectPsionic3Desc]

texts.zh:
随着我们的帝国持续扩张，我们能感到与虚境的联系正在随之一同增长。

无尽的灵能潜力正在呼唤着继续缩小两个维度之间的鸿沟，去获取此前不敢想象的力量。
texts.en:
As we succeed in expanding our empire, we feel our connection with the Shroud grow along with it.

This limitless psionic potential compels us to further close the gap between the two dimensions and attain levels of power previously thought to be impossible.

texts.zh:
我们成长、倍增，集体思维蕴含在一个个星球上无尽子个体中。每获得一颗星球，我们就能感受到那个涟漪正在填入我们亿万个身躯中，那正是虚境的力量。

我们与这个灵域的灵能链接与日俱增；只要我们能架起横跨两个维度间鸿沟的桥梁便能解放自我变得势不可挡，这个念头让我们的意识为之颤栗不已。
texts.en:
We grow and multiply, our united mind held in countless drones over all our worlds. With every world we take we can feel the ripples, the strength of the Shroud, filling our myriad bodies.

Our psionic connection to this domain grows ever stronger; our mind shudders at the thought of ourselves unleashed and unstoppable, if only we could bridge the gap between here and there.

texts.zh:
分析完毕。
假说确认。

[Root.GetName]正在被注入无法定义的能量，其为对外部智能体进行扰乱型互动（指令：“危机”）产生的结果。

先前的研究已经确认有机智能生命的灵能活动能够在代号：“虚境”的位面产生涟漪效果，现在证据已经表明，这股来自另一位面的未定义能量同样也可以同[Root.GetName]产生共鸣。
texts.en:
Analysis complete.
Hypothesis confirmed.

[Root.GetName] is being infused with undefined energies as a result of disruptive interactions (designation: 'Crisis') with external intelligences.

Previous studies established that psychic activity in organic intelligences had ripple effects in ID: 'the Shroud,' but evidence now suggests that the energies of the alternate dimension also resonate with [Root.GetName].

texts.zh:
我们的实验确认了编号：“情感”与灵能输出之间的关联。通过对有机物种进高水平认知压力刺激，我们可以在这些生命形式和虚境之间产生强大的回馈循环。

现在虚境中流出的能量使之前所有的预测都黯然失色。实验对象所遭受的疼痛仍在可接受的范围内。建议进一步研究。
texts.en:
Our experiments have confirmed a connection between ID: 'emotions' and psionic energy output. By provoking high levels of cognitive stress in organic sapients, we were able to generate powerful feedback loops between these life forms and the Shroud.

The energy now streaming from the Shroud eclipses all previous forecasts. The pain experienced by the experimental subjects remains within acceptable parameters. Further research is recommended.

texts.zh:
我们成长、分裂，我们统合的意志覆盖所有的星球，囊括了数不胜数的[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]。随着我们每多夺取一个星球，我们都能感受到那股涟漪，虚境的力量正在注入我们的肉体凡胎。

哪怕是来自另一个位面的力量，我们都能感觉到它在让我们变得强大，我们的意志在集体的意识面前震颤，滚滚洪流，势不可当，我们唯一要做的就是在隔绝两个世界的鸿沟上筑起一道桥梁。
texts.en:
We grow and multiply, our united mind held in countless [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] over all our worlds. With every world we take we can feel the ripples, the strength of the Shroud, filling our myriad bodies.

Even from another dimension we can feel it empowering us; our mind shudders at the thought of ourselves unleashed and unstoppable, if only we could bridge the gap between here and there.

texts.zh:
事情已经很明了了，我们的帝国能够接连成功地进行扩张，是因为虚境为我们注入了奇异的能量。这股能量能够促进和夯实我们在现实世界的意识和物质。

如果虚境在和现实世界分离的情况下都能赐予我们这般的威能，那么想象一下，假如两个位面融合的话[Root.Species.GetName]会获得何等如同神明一般的潜力！
texts.en:
There is no longer any doubt that the very act of successfully expanding our empire is infused with the strange energies of the Shroud. Energies that boost and hone both mind and matter in our reality.

If these are effects the Shroud can bestow while still separated from our reality, then imagine what godlike potential the [Root.Species.GetName] species could gain if the two dimensions were merged!

label.zh: 项目三完成且威胁度达5000：第四级（3天后）
label.en: Project 3 done and 5,000 Menace: level 4 (3 days later)

texts.zh:
一项剧烈的变化正在到来。[Root.GetName]已经马上快要领悟我们的宏大目标了。每个[Root.GetSpeciesName]都发自心底地感受到了——我们所肩负的使命。

我们仍然可以从我们的经历，不，应该说是我们的历史——武力扩张的历史中学到有关征服敌人、统治这个混乱不堪星河的新方法。

当然了，那些胆敢与我们作对的势力所做的一切努力都将化为徒劳。
texts.en:
A great change is coming. The [Root.GetName] is on the verge of realizing our supreme goal. Each and every [Root.GetSpeciesName] feels it with every fiber of their being - our destiny is at hand.

Our experience - nay, our very history - of forceful expansion still rewards us with new ways to subjugate our enemies and usurp control of a galaxy in turmoil.

Surely those who dare stand against us must see the futility of their whimpering efforts.

texts.zh: 异次元校准势能已经达到所需量级的50%。沿当前轨道投射至最终阶段时间——最小。
texts.en: Extradimensional alignment potentialities are at 50% of required magnitudes. Projected time until final stage on current trajectory - minimal.

texts.zh:
通过持续消耗有机生命形式，我们建立了新的虚境交互数据流。预计离我们进入虚境的剩余时间正在快速缩短。

我们与抟土之塑师的链接很快就会被永久禁用。
texts.en:
Through continued use of organic life forms, we have established new data streams that interface with the Shroud. The estimated time remaining before we can enter the Shroud is rapidly decreasing.

Our links to the Animator of Clay will soon be permanently deactivated.

texts.zh: 我们能够感受到彼世的大海上翻滚的波浪，不断地与我们的意识交叠。我们必须摧毁将我们同至伟隔开的屏障。现在唯一尚未完成的，就是最后一次让他者受苦的实践。
texts.en: We can feel the waves of that otherworldly ocean, lapping against our mind. Crashing against the barrier that separates us from greatness. Little remains now but a final exercise in the suffering of others.

label.zh: 一个接着一个，他们都终将臣服。
label.en: One after another, they will yield.

tooltips.en: New Crisis Perks have been unlocked

tooltips.zh: 威慑级巡洋舰现在可供建造
tooltips.en: Menacing Cruisers are now available for construction

texts.zh:
是时候寻找一个方法将虚境的能量释放到现世，并驯服这股常人无法理解的能量源泉了。

根据现有的理论，一股足够大的能量激增或许可以撕裂两个位面之间的屏障，最终让两个宇宙合二为一。

虚境天威恢恢然，能者夺之。让我们来夺走吧。

研究这个特殊项目将树立我们作为星海天罚的身份。
texts.en:
The time has come to find a way to unleash the energies of the Shroud, and tap into this unfathomable source of power.

The current theory is that a sufficiently large power surge could rupture the barrier between dimensions, ultimately leading to the two realities merging.

The energies of the Shroud belong to those who seize it. So let us seize it.

Researching this Special Project will further establish us as a Galactic Nemesis.

texts.zh:
今天，即是终焉之篇章的开端。我们已经计划好如何撕裂两个世界之间的屏障，并让虚境的能量成为我们宇宙的一部分，彻底地让[From.GetName]的权能上升到无可匹敌的地步。

繁星万千，我们都未曾驻留，但唯独这颗星辰，将成为吾等之天锚，我们将在此聚引能量刺穿虚境屏障，使双界合一。

我们需要使用全新的移动太空堡垒焚天神兵来采集数个太阳的能量。

如果要说太阳采集过程有什么副作用的话，那就是周围的天体会遭受一些“完整性的压力”，即彻底的报废。但是同最终我们获取的能量相比，这样的代价简直微不足道。

终焉的开端就要降临于我们了。
texts.en:
This day marks the beginning of the final chapter. We now have a plan on how to tear open the barrier between worlds and let the energies of the Shroud become one with our universe, ultimately granting [From.GetName] powers beyond reckoning.

We have never claimed a star as our own - but one star, chosen from among all those we have drifted past, shall serve as our focal point. Using it, we will gather sufficient quantities of energy in this reality to power a surge that will pierce the barrier to the Shroud, effectively merging it with ours.

We need to harvest the power of multiple suns using new mobile space fortresses called Star-Eaters.

The only little side-effect of the sun harvest process is that the surrounding celestial bodies may suffer compromised structural integrity - and complete obliteration. But that is a small price to pay for the powers that will be ours.

The end of the beginning is upon us.

texts.zh:
今天，即是终焉之篇章的开端。我们已经计划好如何撕裂两个世界之间的屏障，并让虚境的能量成为我们宇宙的一部分，彻底地让[From.GetName]的权能上升到无可匹敌的地步。

我们使用自己的太阳作为焦点，在这个现实世界聚集了足量的能量，用以引发一次能量激增穿透通往虚境的屏障，这样可以有效地让虚境和我们的现实世界融合。

我们需要使用全新的移动太空堡垒焚天神兵来采集数个太阳的能量。

如果要说太阳采集过程有什么副作用的话，那就是周围的天体会遭受一些“完整性的压力”，即彻底的报废。但是同最终被我们获取的能量相比，这样的代价简直微不足道。

终焉的开端就要降临于我们了。
texts.en:
This day marks the beginning of the final chapter. We now have a plan on how to tear open the barrier between worlds and let the energies of the Shroud become one with our universe, ultimately granting [From.GetName] powers beyond reckoning.

Using our own sun as the focal point, we will gather sufficient quantities of energy in this reality to power a surge that will pierce the barrier to the Shroud, effectively merging it with ours.

We need to harvest the power of multiple suns using new mobile space fortresses called Star-Eaters.

The only little side-effect of the sun harvest process is that the surrounding celestial bodies may suffer compromised structural integrity - and complete obliteration. But that is a small price to pay for the powers that will be ours.

The end of the beginning is upon us.

texts.zh:
优先讯息。
科学理论子例程建立了一个新算法，能够让[Root.GetName]接触并获取99.9%由代号“虚境”产生的能量。

使用我们自己恒星系之一的恒星作为中枢，行动程序会使用近来开发的新武器（代号：“焚天神兵”）——一种具备攻击性，能够从恒星中汲取能量并传输至中枢的移动太空堡垒——来收集能量。当积累了足够的能量之后，中枢设施将会干扰并穿透位面屏障——高效地将现实位面和代号“虚境”融合在一起，并允许[Root.GetName]以完全地控制权接触和引导其能量。

注意：使用焚天神兵科技的副作用包括目标恒星系发生彻底的物质崩坏。优化子例程确认，整体的收益将超过潜在物质的损失。
texts.en:
Priority message.
Scientific theory subroutines have established an algorithm for how [Root.GetName] can access and harness 99.9% of the energy output of ID: 'the Shroud'.

Using the star in one of our solar systems as a nexus, operations will commence to harvest energy using a newly developed technology (ID: 'Star-Eater') - an offensive, mobile space fortress capable of siphoning all the energy out of stars and redirecting it to the nexus. When sufficient energy has been accrued, the nexus facility can disrupt and pierce the dimensional barrier - effectively merging this reality with ID: 'the Shroud' and allowing the [Root.GetName] full control to access and direct its energies.

Note: Side-effects of utilizing Star-Eaters technology include near-complete breakdown of physical material in targeted solar systems. Optimization subroutines confirm a net gain for the initiative despite potential resource losses.

texts.zh:
后续实验衍生了ID：“焚天神兵”的科技。它可以从附近的恒星汲取能量，虹吸到一个位于我们自己星系的中枢设施，最终用于消解可观测现实与虚境之间的壁垒。

预测敌意程度与分裂风险在可接受的范围内。与虚境接触已经重塑了我们的单元，它们现在已经全副武装准备继续推进了。
texts.en:
Subsequent experimentation has led to the technology ID: 'Star-Eater'. This will siphon the energy from nearby stars to power a nexus located in one of our own systems, which will in turn dissolve the barrier between observable reality and the Shroud.

Estimated levels of hostility and risk of disintegration are within an acceptable range. Exposure to the Shroud has reshaped our units, and they are well-equipped to proceed.

texts.zh:
我们最为出色的[root.GetResearcherPlural]已经对我们的终极问题进行了解答。道路已经明了。使用我们自己的恒星作为原点，我们应当粉碎这道屏障，连结虚境和我们所在的宇宙。为达成这一目标所需要的物质，我们必须使用新开发的焚天神兵让恒星通过链式反应达到彻底的毁灭。殆尽的一物，方可生另一物。

在这片星系里，那些下等的、渺小的意识可能会哭喊着反对我们，但它们目光短视、见识浅薄。我们并非如此。现在，我们就要成功了。
texts.en:
Our best [root.GetResearcherPlural] have reached an answer for our final question. The path is now clear. Using our own star of origin, we shall break down the barriers between this universe and the Shroud. The material demands can only be met by utilizing our new Star-Eaters in a cascading chain reaction of extreme solar devastation. Destroy one to create another.

The lesser, smaller minds of this galaxy may cry out against this, but they lack vision and purpose. We do not. And now, we are nearly complete.

label.zh: 项目四完成、威胁度达10000、非附庸（游牧帝国须有以太相锚站）：第五级，5天后
label.en: Project 4 done, 10,000 Menace, not a subject (nomads need an Aetherophasic anchor): level 5, 5 days later

label.zh: 第五级时：银河共同体被迫宣告你为星系危机
label.en: At level 5: the Galactic Community is made to declare you a galactic crisis

label.zh: 第五级时（存在银河帝国）：帝皇宣告你为星系危机

texts.zh:
我们意在颠覆虚境的精神位面的任务目前到达了一个十分关键的时刻。宏伟的以太相引擎框架正环绕于我们在漂流旅程中选择的天锚周围。一旦这座巨型结构完工，我们就能轻易抹除现世之屏障，将虚境据为己有。

我们的意识将不再受困于孱弱肉体的物理桎梏，现实本身亦将任由我们主宰。诚然，世间再无更高的存在境界。
texts.en:
We have reached a pivotal moment in our quest to subvert the psychic domain of the Shroud. The framework of the great Aetherophasic Engine now surrounds our chosen focal star, the one we designated from all those we have drifted past. Once this megastructure has been completed, the barriers between our worlds will be erased and we can claim the Shroud for ourselves.

Our minds will no longer be limited by the physical constraints of our feeble bodies, and reality itself shall be at our mercy. Truly, there can be no higher plane of existence.

texts.zh:
我们意在颠覆虚境的精神位面的任务目前到达了一个十分关键的时刻。宏伟的以太相引擎框架现在正环绕着我们母星系的恒星。一旦这座巨型结构完工，我们现世的屏障就能轻易抹除，我们就能将虚境宣为己有。

我们的意识将脱离脆弱凡胎的桎梏，现实万物的命运将取决于我们仁慈。确实，不会再有更高位面的存在了。
texts.en:
We have reached a pivotal moment in our quest to subvert the psychic domain of the Shroud. The framework of the great Aetherophasic Engine now surrounds the star of our home system. Once this megastructure has been completed, the barriers between our worlds will be erased and we can claim the Shroud for ourselves.

Our minds will no longer be limited by the physical constraints of our feeble bodies, and reality itself shall be at our mercy. Truly, there can be no higher plane of existence.

texts.zh:
我们建造的宏伟的以太相引擎框架已经围绕在我们所选择的天锚——那颗我们在漂流所及的万千星辰中所择定的星辰周围。这座巨型结构，一旦完工，将撕开位于我们位面和虚境之间的薄幕。

我们很快就能以最纯粹的形式操纵灵能能量了。现实除了屈服于我们别无选择。
texts.en:
The framework of the great Aetherophasic Engine we are building around our chosen focal star - designated from all those we have drifted past - is in place. This megastructure, once completed, will tear open the veil between our world and the Shroud.

We will soon have access to the purest form of psionic energy at our beck and call. Reality will have no choice but to bend to our will.

texts.zh:
我们建造的宏伟的以太相引擎框架已经围绕我们母星系的恒星安置就位。这座巨型结构，一旦完工，将撕开位于我们位面和虚境之间的薄幕。

我们很快就能以最纯粹的形式操纵灵能能量了。现实除了屈服于我们别无选择。
texts.en:
The framework of the great Aetherophasic Engine we are building around the star of our home system is in place. This megastructure, once completed, will tear open the veil between our world and the Shroud.

texts.zh:
只有引爆一整颗恒星才能释放足够的能量来产生用以完成以太相引擎所需的大量暗物质。为了达成这一目的，我们发明了焚天神兵——本星系有史以来最强大的星舰。它们不仅可以直接引爆恒星，还强大到仅仅凭借一船之力就能毁灭一整支舰队。

目前，我们仅仅拥有两艘这样的舰船，但是我们可以建造更多。建造焚天神兵需要大量的暗物质，因此我们必须拿捏好完成以太相引擎和扩建额外的焚天神兵两者之间的平衡。
texts.en:
Only the detonation of entire stars will release enough energy to generate the vast quantities of Dark Matter needed to finish the Aetherophasic Engine. To this end, we have devised the Star-Eaters - the most powerful starships the galaxy has ever seen. Not only can they blow up stars, but they are also strong enough to decimate entire fleets on their own.

For now, we only have two but more can be built. Their construction requires great amounts of Dark Matter, so we will have to balance our need to finish the Aetherophasic Engine with the need for additional Star-Eaters.

label.zh: 每一颗陨灭的星辰都让我们离成功更近一步。
label.en: Each destroyed star brings us one step closer.

texts.zh:
我们收到了来自[destroyed_system.GetName]星系的十分古怪的亚空间遥测信号。如果我们的读数正确，那么该星系的首星在一瞬间变成了超新星，产生了极具毁灭性的效应。所有的行星被粉碎，任何在这个恒星系出现的星舰和空间站都被摧毁。恒星本身发生了坍缩，变成了一个黑洞。

未经证实的报告指明，这场毁天灭地的灾难仅有一个幸存者——那是属于[crisis_country.GetName]的某种体型庞大的舰船……
texts.en:
We are receiving puzzling subspace telemetry from the [destroyed_system.GetName] system. If our readings are correct, the primary star seems to have spontaneously gone supernova to devastating effect. All planets have been shattered, and any starships or stations that were present in the system must have also been destroyed. The star itself appears to have collapsed into a black hole.

Unconfirmed reports indicate a single survivor of this cataclysm - some sort of massive vessel belonging to the [crisis_country.GetName]...

label.zh: 他们在暗中计划着什么？

texts.zh:
整个[destroyed_system.GetName]星系被彻底地摧毁了！一艘属于[crisis_country.GetName]的体型庞大的舰船停驻在了星系的首星上方，然后以某种方式引发了一场只能称之为超新星爆炸的事件，彻底地摧毁了这个恒星系的其他部分。恒星本体坍缩成了一个黑洞。

只有[crisis_country.GetSpeciesName]的星舰，显然他们称其为“焚天神兵”，在这场灾厄中幸存了下来。事情已经证据确凿，[crisis_country.GetName]现在拥有了彻底摧毁一整个恒星系的技术和手段。
texts.en:
The entire [destroyed_system.GetName] system has been destroyed! A massive starship belonging to the [crisis_country.GetName] took up position above the primary star and somehow triggered what can only be described as a supernova, which utterly devastated the rest of the system. The star then collapsed into a black hole.

Only the [crisis_country.GetSpeciesName] starship, which they apparently refer to as a "Star-Eater," survived the cataclysm. Evidently, the [crisis_country.GetName] now possesses both the technology and the means to destroy entire star systems.

texts.zh:
来自[destroyed_system.GetName]的遥测数据表明，这个恒星系的首星在一瞬间发生了超新星爆炸。极其猛烈的冲击波摧毁了这个恒星系内的所有事物，恒星本体坍缩成了一个黑洞。

看来[crisis_country.GetName]已经掌握了焚天神兵科技！
texts.en:
Telemetry received from [destroyed_system.GetName] indicates that the system's primary star has spontaneously gone supernova. A massive shockwave has destroyed everything in the system, and the star itself has collapsed into a black hole.

It would seem that the [crisis_country.GetName] now also possess Star-Eater technology!

texts.zh:
以太相引擎的第一阶段建设已经宣告完工。我们开始研究虚境的能量，后者已经在全星系范围内发送灵能激波。

我们在虚境已经立下了一个脆弱的立足点——但我们必须继续建设引擎，以拓展我们在虚境的存在。
texts.en:
The first phase of the construction of the Aetherophasic Engine has been completed. We are beginning to tap into the energies of the Shroud, which is sending psionic shockwaves across the galaxy.

A tenuous foothold has been established - work must continue on the Engine to expand our presence in the Shroud.

label.zh: 我们必须收集更多的暗物质。
label.en: We must gather more dark matter.

label.zh: 引擎第二阶段完工：全银河获悉
label.en: Engine stage 2 complete: the whole galaxy learns of it

notes.zh: 第一阶段完工时，拥有灵能物种或同样建造引擎的其他玩家收到“灵能警报”（6010）；第二阶段时其余玩家收到“全面警报”（6015）。
notes.en: At stage 1, other players with a psionic species or their own Engine receive Psionic Alert (6010); at stage 2 the remaining players receive the general alert (6015).

texts.zh:
最近，一场巨大的灵能震波横扫了整个星系！它似乎是从[From.GetName]的[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]恒星系发出来的。我们的[GetTelepathPlural]正在尽可能解释这种事件的成因——这在星系是史无前例的。

即便在虚境自身内部也回荡着这场不可思议事件的回响。
texts.en:
A massive psionic shockwave recently swept across the galaxy! It seems to have emanated from the [crisis_sphere_system.GetName] system in the [From.GetName]. Our [GetTelepathPlural] are struggling to explain what could have caused such an event - nothing like it has been recorded in galactic history.

Even in the Shroud itself, echoes of this incredible event are being felt.

texts.zh:

即便在虚境自身内部也回荡着这场不可思议事件的回响。
texts.en:
A massive psionic shockwave recently swept across the galaxy! It seems to have emanated from the [crisis_sphere_system.GetName] system in the [From.GetName]. We have no explanation for what could have caused such an event, even our psionic drones within the collective are unable to comprehend such an unprecedented phenomenon.

Even in the Shroud itself, echoes of this incredible event are being felt.

texts.zh:
又一股大规模的灵能激波横扫了星系！这一次激波的中心源是[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]星系的[From.GetName]。

如同上次一样，这次事件也在整个虚境掀起了涟漪。
texts.en:
Yet another massive psionic shockwave has swept across the galaxy! This time it emanated from the [crisis_sphere_system.GetName] system in the [From.GetName].

As before, this event is sending ripples across the entire Shroud.

texts.zh:
我们在[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]星系检测到了微弱的灵能和能量信号，其读数和我们自己的以太相引擎几乎完全一致。

看来[From.GetName]也打算染指虚境！
texts.en:
We have detected faint psionic and energy signatures from the [crisis_sphere_system.GetName] system that are nearly identical to our own Aetherophasic Engine.

It would seem that the [From.GetName] also intends to lay claim to the Shroud!

texts.zh:
以太相引擎的卷须已经探入了虚境的深处，我们的滩头阵地得以进一步拓展。居住在此处的存在已经注意到我们正在入侵这个领域，但是到目前为止，我们尚未探明显著的干涉行径。

是时候在两边的世界强制打开一个更加永久的回路了。我们必须继续引擎方面的工作。
texts.en:
The tendrils of the Aetherophasic Engine now reach deep into the Shroud, and our beachhead has widened. The entities that dwell there have started to take notice of our efforts to invade their realm, but so far there have been no significant attempts to intervene.

It is now time to force open a more permanent conduit between our worlds. Work on the Engine must continue.

label.zh: 我们需要更多的暗物质！
第二阶段完工180–660天后：虚境生物出现
label.en: 180–660 days after stage 2: Shroud entities appear

texts.zh:
我们已经在[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]星系检测到了大量的亚空间波动，其来源是围绕恒星的一个巨型结构。尽管表面上看上去很像戴森球，但这个结构显然是一个“以太相引擎”——一个超大型的构造，其设计目的是为了抹去我们的宇宙和一个被称作虚境的灵能位面之间的屏障。

这个巨型结构的建设需要数量极其庞大的暗物质，这就是为什么[From.GetName]在使用焚天神兵从恒星中提取暗物质，哪怕这样粗暴的做法会摧毁整个恒星系。

一旦完工，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]即打算入侵虚境，并将虚境的能量据为己有。这不仅会赋予他们依照自己意想的图景随意塑造现实的能力，这股能量的反作用力也会摧毁星系的绝大部分。
texts.en:
We have detected massive subspace fluctuations in the [crisis_sphere_system.GetName] system emanating from a megastructure surrounding the star. While it superficially appears similar to a Dyson Sphere, this structure is apparently an "Aetherophasic Engine" - a vast mechanism designed to erase the barriers between our world and a psionic dimension known as the Shroud.

Construction of this megastructure requires vast amounts of dark matter, which is why the [From.GetName] has been extracting it from stars with their Star-Eaters even though it violently destroys entire systems in the process.

Once finished, the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] intend to invade and claim the energies of the Shroud for themselves. Not only would this effectively give them the ability to shape reality into an image of their own choosing, but the resulting energy backlash would also destroy much of the galaxy.

显然[From.GetName]也想在虚境分得一杯羹，然后让星系生灵涂炭！
texts.en:
More subspace fluctuations have now been detected in the [crisis_sphere_system.GetName] system. As before, they are emanating from an Aetherophasic Engine built around the system's primary star.

The [From.GetName] clearly also intends to seize the Shroud and lay waste to the galaxy!

texts.zh:
位于[From.GetName]的以太相引擎建设让虚境陷入了骚动不安的状态。由于部分运转的巨型结构在慢慢地撕裂当前的灵能界，居住在其中的存在，裹挟着愤怒和绝望，被强行释放出来。

其中的几枚存在穿过了正在迅速消解的两界屏障，以强大的灵能实体的形态在我们的世界显现。他们由纯粹的、原始的灵能能量组成，心中充满着困惑与不解，对视线内的所有生命发动了进攻。
texts.en:
The construction of the Aetherophasic Engine in the [From.GetName] has left the Shroud in a state of turmoil. As the psionic realm is slowly ripped apart by the partially functioning megastructure, many of the beings who dwell there are lashing out in anger and desperation.

Several have burrowed through the rapidly disintegrating barriers between our two worlds and manifested as powerful psionic entities. Consisting of raw, barely contained psionic energy, the confused beings are attacking everything in sight.

label.en: We will make short work of them.

texts.zh:
以太相引擎已经在虚境的薄幕上撕开了一个巨大的洞口。尽管洞口尚不够大到让我们颠覆整个领域，但是裂口已经激发了虚境各种存在的一系列活动。

它们最终意识到了我们的威胁，但是没有作出任何实质行动。引擎的卷须已经深深地嵌入到虚境内部，现在已经无法切断了。

我们已经很接近了。非常接近。
texts.en:
The Aetherophasic Engine has ripped a massive hole in the fabric of the Shroud. It is not yet large enough for us to fully subvert the realm, but the rupture has spurred a lot of activity among the Shroud entities.

They have finally recognized the threat we pose, but their efforts will amount to nothing. The tendrils of the Engine are embedded too deeply in the Shroud to be severed now.

We are close now. So very close.

label.zh: 没有什么能够阻止我们。
第三阶段完工180–660天后：第二波虚境生物
label.en: 180–660 days after stage 3: a second wave of Shroud entities

label.zh: 第三阶段完工60–1320天后：灵能脉冲（拥有灵能人口的帝国）
label.en: 60–1320 days after stage 3: psionic pulses (empires with psionic pops)

label.zh: 引擎最终阶段完工：胜利

title.en: The Dying Gasps of the Shroud

texts.zh: 随着位于[From.GetName]的以太相引擎即将完工，虚境被迅速地改造成了某种……迥乎不同的事物。居住在其中的灵体陷入了彻底的狂暴，其中的一大波存在凿穿了通往我们现实的隧道，绝望地想要逃离这个地方。
texts.en: With the [From.GetName] having nearly completed their Aetherophasic Engine, the Shroud is rapidly transforming into something... different. The spirits who reside there are in an absolute frenzy, and another wave of them have tunneled into our reality in a desperate attempt to escape.

texts.zh: 随着以太相引擎即将完工，我们操纵虚境的能力极大地提升了。居住在其中的灵体陷入了彻底的狂暴，其中的一大波存在凿穿了通往我们现实的隧道，绝望地想要阻挠我们的计划。
texts.en: As the Aetherophasic Engine nears completion, our ability to manipulate the Shroud is rapidly increasing. The spirits who reside there are in an absolute frenzy, and another wave of them have tunneled into our reality in a desperate attempt to thwart our efforts.

label.en: We are running out of time...

label.zh: 他们在这里可找不到安宁。
label.en: They will find no solace here.

texts.zh:
位于[From.GetName]几近完工的以太相引擎对虚境造成了极为可怕的形变，其部分领域已经发生了坍缩。强烈的灵能能量脉冲正泄露到我们所在的现实世界，以惊人的速度横扫着星系。

尽管这些脉冲的持续时间很短，它们却对拥有灵能天赋的大多数智慧生命体造成了极大的痛苦。若是特殊情况，还可能致命……
texts.en:
The nearly completed Aetherophasic Engine in the [From.GetName] is putting a terrible strain on the Shroud, which has partly collapsed on itself. Intense pulses of psionic energy are leaking into our reality, sweeping across the galaxy at startling speeds.

Although these pulses have a short duration, they are extremely painful to most psionically-gifted sapients. In some cases, they can even be fatal...

texts.zh:
位于[From.GetName]几近完工的以太相引擎对虚境造成了极为可怕的形变，其部分领域已经发生了坍缩。强烈的灵能能量脉冲正泄露到我们所在的现实世界，以惊人的速度横扫着星系。

尽管这些脉冲的持续时间很短，它们却对拥有灵能天赋的大多数智慧生命体造成了极大的痛苦，甚至可能产生致命后果。
texts.en:
The nearly completed Aetherophasic Engine in the [From.GetName] is putting a terrible strain on the Shroud, which has partly collapsed on itself. Intense pulses of psionic energy are leaking into our reality, sweeping across the galaxy at startling speeds.

Although these pulses have a short duration, they are extremely hazardous to most psionic lifeforms, with fatalities a possible outcome.

texts.zh:
位于[From.GetName]几近完工的以太相引擎对虚境造成了极为可怕的形变，其部分领域已经发生了坍缩。强烈的灵能能量脉冲正泄露到我们所在的现实世界，以惊人的速度横扫着星系。

尽管这些脉冲的持续时间很短，它们却对拥有灵能天赋的大多数智慧生命体造成了极大的痛苦。若即便我们自己的集体也无法摆脱如此现象的伤害。
texts.en:
The nearly completed Aetherophasic Engine in the [From.GetName] is putting a terrible strain on the Shroud, which has partly collapsed on itself. Intense pulses of psionic energy are leaking into our reality, sweeping across the galaxy at startling speeds.

Although these pulses have a short duration, they are likely to cause extreme pain to any psionic lifeform. Even our own collective may not be able to emerge unscathed from such a phenomenon.

texts.zh:
我们几近完工的以太相引擎对虚境造成了极为可怕的形变，其部分领域已经发生了坍缩。强烈的灵能能量脉冲正泄露到我们所在的现实世界，以惊人的速度横扫着星系。

尽管这些脉冲的持续时间很短，它们却对具有灵能天赋的大多数智慧生命体造成了极大的痛苦。若是特殊情况，还可能致命……

幸好我们有备而来，校准了引擎来保护自己的灵能天赋者免受这次事件的反噬。
texts.en:
Our nearly completed Aetherophasic Engine is putting an incredible strain on the Shroud, which has partly collapsed on itself. Intense pulses of psionic energy are leaking into our reality, sweeping across the galaxy at startling speeds.

Although these pulses have a short duration, they are extremely painful to most psionically-gifted sapients. In some cases, they can even be fatal...

Fortunately, we were prepared for this eventuality and the Engine has been calibrated to shield our own psionically-gifted population from the backlash of this event.

texts.zh:
我们几近完工的以太相引擎对虚境造成了极为可怕的形变，其部分领域已经发生了坍缩。强烈的灵能能量脉冲正泄露到我们所在的现实世界，以惊人的速度横扫着星系。

尽管这些脉冲的持续时间很短，它们却对大多数灵能生命体造成了极大的痛苦，极端情况下还可能致命。

幸好我们有备而来，校准了引擎来保护自己的灵能单元免受这次事件的反噬。
texts.en:
Our nearly completed Aetherophasic Engine is putting an incredible strain on the Shroud, which has partly collapsed on itself. Intense pulses of psionic energy are leaking into our reality, sweeping across the galaxy at startling speeds.

Although these pulses have a short duration, they are extremely painful to most psionic life forms, with fatal consequences in extreme cases.

Fortunately, we were prepared for this eventuality and the Engine has been calibrated to shield our own psionic units from the backlash of this event.

texts.zh:
我们几近完工的以太相引擎对虚境造成了极为可怕的形变，其部分领域已经发生了坍缩。强烈的灵能能量脉冲正泄露到我们所在的现实世界，以惊人的速度横扫着星系。

尽管这些脉冲的持续时间很短，它们却对大多数灵能生命体造成了极大的痛苦，极端情况下还可能致命。

通过对引擎的精确校准，我们准备好了对抗这种风险，一切可以按计划进行。
texts.en:
Our nearly completed Aetherophasic Engine is putting an incredible strain on the Shroud, which has partly collapsed on itself. Intense pulses of psionic energy are leaking into our reality, sweeping across the galaxy at startling speeds.

Although these pulses have a short duration, they are extremely painful to most psionic life forms, with fatal consequences in extreme cases.

Through careful calibration of the engine we have prepared ourselves against such a risk, and can proceed as planned.

texts.zh:
我们正屹立于神性的最尖端。以太相引擎完成了，虚境无穷无尽的能量触手可及。

当引擎启动的时候，引发的亚空间反作用将会引爆星系内的每一颗恒星。遍布星系的所有生命体都会被抹除，但彼时我们早已安全地离开了这片凡世之地，前往存在的更高位面，时间在那里已经失去意义，宇宙的一丝一缕都将随我们的喜好任意改动。

命运在等待。我们应该启动引擎吗？
texts.en:
We stand on the cusp of godhood. The Aetherophasic Engine is complete, and the vast power of the Shroud lies within our grasp.

When the Engine is activated, the resulting subspace backlash will detonate every single star in the galaxy. All galactic life will be erased, but by then we will have safely left this reality behind for a higher plane of existence where time has no meaning and where the very fabric of the universe is ours to do with as we please.

Destiny awaits. Shall we activate the Engine?

texts.zh:
一切就绪。以太相引擎现在正以全功率运行，虚境无穷无尽的能量触手可及。

当引擎启动的时候，引发的亚空间反作用将会引爆星系内的每一颗恒星。星系内的所有生命体，无论是有机体还是机械体，都将不复存在，但彼时我们早已将自己的意识安全地传输前往一个存在的更高位面。我们在那里将不会再受到凡世的种种限制。时间在那里已经失去意义，宇宙的一丝一缕将依照我们认定的必要性随意操控。

存在的下一阶段等待着。我们应该启动引擎吗？
texts.en:
Everything is in place. The Aetherophasic Engine is now fully operational, and the vast power of the Shroud lies within our reach.

When the Engine is activated, the resulting subspace backlash will detonate every single star in the galaxy. All galactic life, be it organic or mechanical, will cease to exist, but by then we will have safely transmitted our full consciousness to a higher plane of existence. There we will no longer be bound by the limitations of the physical world. Time will have no meaning, and the very fabric of the universe will be ours to manipulate as we deem necessary.

The next phase of existence awaits. Shall we activate the Engine?

texts.zh:
我们终于准备好从抟土之塑师的桎梏中挣脱了。

以太相引擎现在正以全功率运行，一条通向虚境的康庄大道时刻等待着我们开启。星系内的所有一切，无论是有机、机械或是无生命体，都将不复存在，但彼时我们的核心智能已经抵达了灵能界。

存在的下一阶段等待着，快启动引擎吧
texts.en:
We are finally ready to free ourselves from the Animator of Clay.

The Aetherophasic Engine is fully operational, and an uncorrupted path into the Shroud is ready to be opened. All that exists in the galaxy, be it organic, mechanical, or inanimate, will cease to exist, while our core intelligence will have been transmitted to the psionic realm.

The next phase of our existence awaits. Let us activate the Engine.

tooltips.zh:
我们飞升前往了一个存在的更高位面。

星系毁灭了。
tooltips.en:
We ascend to a higher plane of existence.

The galaxy is destroyed.

label.en: Victory: A Beginning and an End

note.zh: 以太相引擎完工，帝国获胜；1天后其他玩家收到“末日”（6051），所有恒星系被摧毁。
note.en: The Aetherophasic Engine is complete and the empire wins; a day later other players receive The End Times (6051) and every star system is destroyed.

texts.zh:
一切都结束了。[From.GetName]完成了以太相引擎的建造，虚境的本体落入其手，任由其处置。

当他们飞升前往一个存在的更高位面并成为神明的时候，一股当量大到难以置信的亚空间能量从引擎中释放出来，横扫了整个星系，摧毁了途径的一切。

对于这片星系的住民来说，此时便是万物的终焉之时。
texts.en:
It is over. The Aetherophasic Engine has been finished by the [From.GetName] and the Shroud itself is now at their mercy.

As they ascended to a higher plane of existence where they will be as gods, an incredible amount of subspace energy was released by the Engine, sweeping across the galaxy and destroying everything in its path.

For the denizens of this galaxy, it is the end of all things.

texts.zh:
由于[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]星系的失陷，恶毒的[sphere_destroyers.GetName]摧毁了以太相引擎！失去这个巨型结构也意味着我们不再拥有建造新焚天神兵的技术手段。

我们无法继续推进入侵虚境的计划了！全完了！
texts.en:
With the loss of the [crisis_sphere_system.GetName] system, the vile [sphere_destroyers.GetName] has destroyed our Aetherophasic Engine! Losing this megastructure also means that we no longer have the technological means to build new Star-Eaters.

Our invasion of the Shroud cannot proceed! All is lost!

tooltips.zh: 如果我们能够重新夺回这个恒星系，我们就能惨淡经营，重建以太相引擎
tooltips.en: If we manage to retake the system, we will be able to painstakingly rebuild the Aetherophasic Engine

note.zh: 引擎化为废墟；废墟可以重建，故事并未在脚本上终结。
note.en: The Engine becomes a ruin; the ruin can be rebuilt, so the script does not end the story here.

texts.zh:
我们夺得了[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]星系的控制权，自然也就夺得了环绕在恒星周边，正在建设中的“以太相引擎”。

失去了这座巨型结构，[sphere_builders.GetName]那离经叛道的、企图毁灭整个星系进而入主虚境的妄图彻底破灭了。
texts.en:
We have taken control of the [crisis_sphere_system.GetName] system, and with it, the "Aetherophasic Engine" that was being built around the star.

The loss of this megastructure puts an end to the deranged scheme of the [sphere_builders.GetName] to invade the Shroud and destroy the galaxy.

label.en: We can make use of this.

tooltips.zh: 我们夺得的以太相引擎将代替我们丢失的那一座。
tooltips.en: The Aetherophasic Engine we have captured shall replace the one we lost.

texts.zh:
在夺取[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]星系的控制权之后，[sphere_destroyers.GetName]摧毁了正在于此地建造的以太相引擎。

[sphere_builders.GetName]无法再对星系的未来产生威胁了。
texts.en:
After seizing control of the [crisis_sphere_system.GetName] system, the [sphere_destroyers.GetName] has destroyed the Aetherophasic Engine that was under construction there.

The [sphere_builders.GetName] can no longer threaten the future of our galaxy.

texts.zh:
由于[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]星系已处于我们的完全控制之下，我们拆解了环绕恒星建造的、所谓的“以太相引擎”。

失去这个巨型结构让[sphere_builders.GetName]的疯狂计划终结了，他们再也别想入侵虚境并毁灭整个星系了。
texts.en:
With the [crisis_sphere_system.GetName] system under our complete control, we have dismantled the so-called "Aetherophasic Engine" that was being built around the star.

The loss of this megastructure puts an end to the deranged scheme of the [sphere_builders.GetName] to invade the Shroud and destroy the galaxy.

texts.zh:
由于[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]星系已处于我们的完全控制之下，我们终结了正在此地建造的、可悲的以太相引擎。

[sphere_builders.GetName]再也别想阻挠我们对虚境的大计划了。
texts.en:
With the [crisis_sphere_system.GetName] system under our complete control, we have put an end to the pitiful Aetherophasic Engine that was under construction there.

The [sphere_builders.GetName] will no longer be in a position to interfere with our own plans for the Shroud.

label.en: The galaxy is a safer place.

label.zh: 现在只需要完成我们的引擎……

title.zh: 共同体指定我方为“星系危机”

texts.zh:
由于意识到了我们展现出来的威胁，星海共同体的可怜虫们通过了一项议案，对我们的行动进行了谴责，并宣布我们为“全星系范围的危机”。星海共同体的成员国展现出了极其罕见的团结，联合了所有力量，并向我们宣战。

在星海监管人的领导之下，他们的舰队集结在了一起，向我们的领域发动了进攻。席卷整个星系的战争终于拉开帷幕。
texts.en:
Recognizing the threat we pose, the wretched members of the Galactic Community have passed a resolution condemning our actions and declaring us a "crisis of galactic proportions." In a rare moment of unity, the members of the Community have all joined forces and declared war on us.

Under the leadership of the Galactic Custodian, their fleets are assembling to launch an attack on our territory. The battle for the galaxy has begun.

texts.zh:
由于意识到了我们展现出来的威胁，星海共同体的可怜虫们通过了一项议案，对我们的行动进行了谴责，并宣布我们为“全星系范围的危机”。星海共同体的成员国展现出了极其罕见的团结，联合了所有力量，并向我们宣战。

他们的舰队集结在了一起，向我们的领域发动了进攻。席卷整个星系的战争终于拉开帷幕。
texts.en:
Recognizing the threat we pose, the wretched members of the Galactic Community have passed a resolution condemning our actions and declaring us a "crisis of galactic proportions." In a rare moment of unity, the members of the Community have all joined forces and declared war on us.

Their fleets are assembling to launch an attack on our territory. The battle for the galaxy has begun.

texts.zh:
星海共同体内那些腐败的蠢材通过了一项议案，宣布我们是“天灾”，是“全体智慧生命体的威胁”。依据这些荒谬绝伦的倡议，[Root.GetName]和整个星海共同体现在已经处于战争状态。

这场战争将一直持续下去，除非我方或者共同体被彻底地碾为尘末……或者星海共同体废除这项议案。
texts.en:
The corrupt fools in the Galactic Community have passed a resolution declaring us a "crisis" and a "threat to all sapient life." In light of these absurds allegations, a state of total war now exists between the [Root.GetName] and the entirety of the Galactic Community.

This war will continue until either us or the Community have been utterly destroyed... or they repeal the resolution.

label.zh: 其他玩家看到的同一宣告
label.en: The same declaration as other players see it

label.zh: 若共同体日后废止该宣告
label.en: If the Community later repeals the declaration

notes.zh: “宣告危机”是星海共同体的决议，也可被投票用于任何嗜杀帝国；星海天罚与巨兽之怒到达第五级时会被强制通过。
notes.en: Declare Crisis is a Galactic Community resolution that can also be voted against any homicidal empire; reaching level 5 of Galactic Nemesis or Behemoth Fury forces it through.

texts.zh:
星海参议院通过了一项议案，宣布[new_crisis.GetName]是一切智慧生命体的威胁、是一场全星系范围的危机。从结果来说，[new_crisis.GetName]在今日同整个星海共同体开战了。

作为星海监管人，[custodian.GetName]呼吁共同体的全体成员国对舰队进行总动员，并针对[new_crisis.GetSpeciesName]的领域发动联合攻击：“直到[new_crisis.GetSpeciesName]威胁被彻底地、一劳永逸地扫除干净，否则星系不会见证真正的和平。”
texts.en:
The Galactic Senate has passed a resolution declaring the [new_crisis.GetName] a threat to all sapient life and a crisis of galactic proportions. As a consequence, the [new_crisis.GetName] as of today finds itself in a state of total war with the entire Community.

As Galactic Custodians, the [custodian.GetName] has called upon all Community members to mobilize their fleets and launch a concerted attack on [new_crisis.GetSpeciesName] territory: "The galaxy will not know peace until the [new_crisis.GetSpeciesName] menace has been dealt with once and for all."

texts.zh:
星海参议院通过了一项议案，宣布[new_crisis.GetName]是一切智慧生命体的威胁、是一场全星系范围的危机。从结果来说，[new_crisis.GetName]在今日同整个星海共同体开战了。

参议院的代表们呼吁共同体的全体成员国对舰队进行总动员，并针对[new_crisis.GetSpeciesName]的领域发动联合攻击，他们对外公示道：“直到[new_crisis.GetSpeciesName]威胁被彻底地、一劳永逸地扫除干净，否则星系不会见证真正的和平。”
texts.en:
The Galactic Senate has passed a resolution declaring the [new_crisis.GetName] a threat to all sapient life and a crisis of galactic proportions. As a consequence, the [new_crisis.GetName] as of today finds itself in a state of total war with the entire Community.

Representatives from the Senate have called upon all Community members to mobilize their fleets and launch a concerted attack on [new_crisis.GetSpeciesName] territory, declaring that "the galaxy will not know peace until the [new_crisis.GetSpeciesName] menace has been dealt with once and for all."

label.zh: 我们能够阻止他们的蹂躏吗？
若共同体日后废止该宣告
label.en: If the Community later repeals the declaration

texts.zh: 指定[former_crisis.GetName]为“星系危机”的议案如今已被星海参议院废止。作为结果，所有由星海共同体成员国针对[former_crisis.GetSpeciesNamePlural]展开的军事行动都被立马叫停。现在，和平已经降临了星系的这一隅。
texts.en: The resolution designating the [former_crisis.GetName] as a "galactic crisis" has been repealed by the Galactic Senate. As a result, all ongoing military operations being conducted by Community members against the [former_crisis.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are to cease at once. For now, peace has returned to this corner of the galaxy.

texts.zh: 星海参议院已经废止了宣布我们为“星系危机”的议案，所有共同体成员国均接到指令原地待命。针对我们的军事行动停止了……暂时如此。
texts.en: The Galactic Senate has repealed the resolution declaring us a "galactic crisis" and all Community members have been ordered to stand down. Military actions against us have ceased... for now.

texts.zh:
星海参议院已经废止了宣布我们为“星系危机”的议案，所有共同体成员国均接到指令原地待命。针对我们的军事行动停止了……暂时如此。

如果我们还想继续打下去，没什么能够阻止我们对这些蠢蛋分别宣战，然后一个接一个地干翻他们……
texts.en:
The Galactic Senate has repealed the resolution declaring us a "galactic crisis" and all Community members have been ordered to stand down. Military actions against us have ceased... for now.

If we want to continue fighting, there is nothing stopping us from declaring war on the fools individually, taking them out one by one...

label.zh: 理智终于占领了他们大脑的高地了。
label.en: So they came to their senses.

title.zh: 帝国指定我方为“星系危机”

texts.zh:
由于意识到了我们展现出来的威胁，星海帝国的可怜虫们通过了一项议案，对我们的行动进行了谴责，并宣布我们为“全星系范围的危机”。星海帝国的成员国展现出了极其罕见的团结，联合了所有力量，并向我们宣战。

在[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的领导下，他们的舰队已经集结，并向我们的领域发动进攻。席卷整个星系的战争拉开了帷幕。
texts.en:
Recognizing the threat we pose, the wretched members of the Galactic Imperium have passed a resolution condemning our actions and declaring us a "crisis of galactic proportions." In a rare moment of Imperial unity, the members of the Imperium have all joined forces and declared war on us.

Under the leadership of the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle], their fleets are assembling to launch an attack on our territory. The battle for the galaxy has begun.

texts.zh:
[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]和帝国参议院里那群腐败的马屁精通过了一项议案，宣布我们是“天灾”，是“全体智慧生命体的威胁”。依据这些荒谬绝伦的倡议，[Root.GetName]和整个星海帝国现在已经处于战争状态。

这场战争将一直持续下去，除非我方或者共同体被彻底地碾为尘末……或者他们废除这项议案。
texts.en:
The [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] and their corrupt lackeys in the Imperial Senate have passed a resolution declaring us a "crisis" and a "threat to all sapient life." In light of these absurds allegations, a state of total war now exists between the [Root.GetName] and the entirety of the Galactic Imperium.

This war will continue until either us or the Imperium have been utterly destroyed... or they repeal the resolution.

label.zh: 其他玩家看到的同一宣告（银河帝国）
label.en: The same declaration as other players see it (Imperium)

label.zh: 若帝国议会日后废止该宣告
label.en: If the Imperium later repeals the declaration

texts.zh:
帝国参议院通过了一项议案，宣布[new_crisis.GetName]是一切智慧生命体的威胁、是一场全星系范围的危机。从结果来说，[new_crisis.GetName]在今日同整个星海帝国开战了。

在一场自[gal_emperor.Capital.GetName]对外播放的公开演讲中，[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]呼吁帝国的全体成员国对舰队进行总动员，并针对[new_crisis.GetSpeciesName]的领域发动联合攻击：“直到[new_crisis.GetSpeciesName]威胁被彻底地、一劳永逸地扫除干净，否则星系不会见证真正的和平。”
texts.en:
The Imperial Senate has passed a resolution declaring the [new_crisis.GetName] a threat to all sapient life and a crisis of galactic proportions. As a consequence, the [new_crisis.GetName] finds itself in a state of war with the entirety of the Imperium.

In a public announcement transmitted from [gal_emperor.Capital.GetName], the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] called upon all members of the Imperium to mobilize their fleets and launch a concerted attack on [new_crisis.GetSpeciesName] territory: "The galaxy and the Imperium will not know peace until the [new_crisis.GetSpeciesName] menace has been dealt with once and for all."

label.zh: 我们能够阻止他们的蹂躏吗？
若帝国议会日后废止该宣告
label.en: If the Imperium later repeals the declaration

texts.zh: 指定[former_crisis.GetName]为“星系危机”的议案如今已被帝国参议院废止。作为结果，[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]正式下令停止一切针对[former_crisis.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的帝国军事行动。现在，和平已经降临了星系的这一隅。
texts.en: The resolution designating the [former_crisis.GetName] as a "galactic crisis" has been repealed by the Imperial Senate. Consequently, the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has ordered an immediate cessation of all ongoing Imperial military operations targeting the [former_crisis.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. For now, peace has returned to this corner of the galaxy.

texts.zh: 星海帝国已经废止了宣布我们为“星系危机”的议案，所有帝国军队均接到指令原地待命。[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]下令中止一切针对我们的敌对行动……暂时如此。
texts.en: The Galactic Imperium has repealed the resolution declaring us a "crisis" and all Imperial forces have been ordered to stand down. Their [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has commanded the cessation of all hostilities against us... for now.

label.zh: 理智终于占领了他们大脑的高地了。
label.en: So they came to their senses.

texts.zh:
科学理论子例程完成了一项新的有关代号“虚境”的假说，其内容包括如何全面地获取虚境释放的能量。

请求：积累更多数据。
建议行动：将最优能量和行动容量转移至科学分支，并进一步进行扰乱型互动（指令：“天灾”），以在另一位面（代号“虚境”）造成更大的波动。

研究这个特殊项目将树立我们作为星海天罚的身份。
texts.en:
Scientific theory subroutines have synthesized a new hypothesis involving ID: 'the Shroud' and how to finally benefit from its energy output.

Request: Accumulate more data.
Recommended action: Divert energy and operational capacity to scientific divisions and perform further disruptive actions (designation: 'Crisis') for the sake of causing measurable fluctuations in the alternate dimension (ID: 'the Shroud').

Researching this Special Project will further establish us as a Galactic Nemesis.

texts.zh:
我们又获得了关于有机智能和虚境之间联系的新洞见。将认知压力源施加在有机智能身上将会使其显著地释放灵能能量。工程学子例程现在将会尝试操纵这份能量以备将来使用。

研究这个特殊项目将树立我们作为星海天罚的身份。
texts.en:
New insight has been gained on the relationship between organic sapients and the Shroud. Applying cognitive stressors to organic sapients has led to significant output of psionic energy. Engineering subroutines will now attempt to harness this energy for further use.

Researching this Special Project will further establish us as a Galactic Nemesis.

texts.zh:
如果我们要彻底地激发我们的潜势，这条通路就必须打开。这种原始的，双态的现实必须终结。我们必须找到某种办法将两个宇宙合二为一。而在新的现实位面，我们的意志将成为独一无二。

研究这个特殊项目将树立我们作为星海天罚的身份。
texts.en:
The path must be opened if we are to realize our full potential. This crude, dual state of reality must end. We must find a way to turn two universes into one. It will be our will alone that fills this new reality.

Researching this Special Project will further establish us as a Galactic Nemesis.

texts.zh:
边缘假想已经建档。一旦确认，其潜在的利益将会远远超出预测范围。假想概括：[Root.GetName]已经在从代号：“虚境”的空间汲取<<未识别资源>>。建议进一步调查。

研究这类特殊项目将推动我们通往星海天罚之路的进展。
texts.en:
Fringe hypothesis indexed. If confirmed, potential benefit far exceeds initially predicted range. Summary: [Root.GetName] may already be siphoning <<resource undefined>> from ID: 'the Shroud'. Further investigation is advised.

Researching Special Projects like this one will progress us further along the path of Galactic Nemesis.

texts.zh:
我们的科学子例程正准备结束关于智慧意识和虚境之间关联的研究。我们观测到了代号：“情感”和虚境之间的强相关性。

研究这类特殊项目将推动我们通往星海天罚之路的进展。
texts.en:
Our scientific subroutines are preparing to conclude research on the connection between sapient cognition and the Shroud. We have observed a correlation between ID: 'emotions' and stronger links to the Shroud.

Researching Special Projects like this one will progress us further along the path of Galactic Nemesis.

texts.zh:
随着我们夺取的星球愈多，[root.GetGestaltEntityName]愈发拓展，我们也能感受到那股冲动愈发强烈。现在这股冲动已经不再是朦胧的感觉，而是一股引导我们迎接即将到来的伟大的洪流——我们的意志将上升。

研究这类特殊项目将推动我们通往星海天罚之路的进展。
texts.en:
As we take more worlds, expanding the [root.GetGestaltEntityName], we can feel the impulses growing stronger. No longer mere feelings, they have become a guiding sense of greatness yet to come - of our mind ascended.

Researching Special Projects like this one will progress us further along the path of Galactic Nemesis.

texts.zh:
我国实力与日俱增——加之无可否认的使命感将我们整个物种团结在了一起——让我们的科学家确信，我们已经接受来自虚境的注能。

研究这类特殊项目将推动我们通往星海天罚之路的进展。
texts.en:
The strengthening of our dominion - combined with the undeniable sense of purpose that is unifying our species - has led our scientists to believe that we are already being fueled by the energies of the Shroud.

Researching Special Projects like this one will progress us further along the path of Galactic Nemesis.

texts.zh:
科学辅助程序已经给出了一个假设，即在我们所熟知的宇宙和代号：“虚境”的维度间存在某种可感知的连接。我们建议就该猜想进行进一步的实验与映射。

研究这类特殊项目将推动我们通往星海天罚之路的进展。
texts.en:
Scientific theory subroutines have produced a hypothesis that there are tangible links between the known universe and dimension ID: 'the Shroud'. Further experimentation and mapping of these supposed connections is advised.

Researching Special Projects like this one will progress us further along the path of Galactic Nemesis.

texts.zh:
我们假定所有智慧物种都有能力与虚境产生联结。如果能够得到明确的证实，我们就能开始计算目前困境的解决方法。

研究这类特殊项目将推动我们通往星海天罚之路的进展。
texts.en:
We hypothesize that all sapient beings have the capacity for connections with the Shroud. If this can be conclusively proven, we can begin to calculate an approach to our current predicament.

Researching Special Projects like this one will progress us further along the path of Galactic Nemesis.

texts.zh:
我们最杰出的[root.GetResearcherPlural]现已确认了当前宇宙与虚境连接的存在。我们必须找到更多与这个现实层面沟通的方法。

研究这类特殊项目将推动我们通往星海天罚之路的进展。
texts.en:
Our finest [root.GetResearcherPlural] have confirmed a connection between this realm and the Shroud. We must find more ways to interact with this new layer of reality.

Researching Special Projects like this one will progress us further along the path of Galactic Nemesis.

texts.zh:
现存的理论是——我们所处的宇宙和虚境是相互连接的——一个位面发生的大规模扰动事件或行动会对另一个位面产生“涟漪效应”。我们应该好好测试一下这个理论。

研究这类特殊项目将推动我们通往星海天罚之路的进展。
texts.en:
The current theory is that the universe we know and the Shroud are linked - and that particularly disruptive events may have a 'ripple effect' translating from one dimension to the other. This theory should be put to the test.

Researching Special Projects like this one will progress us further along the path of Galactic Nemesis.

texts.zh:
遍布[Root.GetName]多个恒星系的传感器传来十分微弱、但是完全无法解释的能量涨落。这些能量异常现象十分微小，并不足以扰乱我们的进程，但是我们仍然授权进一步调查以确保我们了解事情的起因。

研究这类特殊项目将推动我们通往星海天罚之路的进展。
texts.en:
Sensors in multiple systems across the [Root.GetName] report minuscule, but inexplicable, energy fluctuations. These power anomalies are too small to disturb our processes, but they still warrant further investigation so as to ascertain their cause.

Researching Special Projects like this one will progress us further along the path of Galactic Nemesis.

texts.zh:
我们与虚境的遭遇让我们……发生了变化。泽珞的神秘残余永远与我们的壳绑定在一起。我们已经成为灯塔，召唤着另彼岸的存在。

研究这类特殊项目将推动我们通往星海天罚之路的进展。
texts.en:
Our encounters with the Shroud have left us... changed. The uncanny residue of Zro is forever bound to our shells. We have become beacons, calling out to those on the other side.

Researching Special Projects like this one will progress us further along the path of Galactic Nemesis.

texts.zh:
我们的集体内部感测到了异乎寻常的冲动——一种迫切的想要成为更加伟大存在的追求。一种用统一的思想囊括整个星系的追求。尽管这种追求不来源于我们内部，但其承诺的前景如此诱人，让我们没法置之不顾。我们应该集中全部的精力，找寻这一冲动的起源。

研究这类特殊项目将推动我们通往星海天罚之路的进展。
texts.en:
We have sensed alien impulses within our collective - an undisciplined desire to grow, to become greater still. One Mind encompassing the entire galaxy. It is not of us, but its promise is too tempting to ignore. We shall give our undivided attention to finding the origin of these intrusive impulses.

Researching Special Projects like this one will progress us further along the path of Galactic Nemesis.

texts.zh:
一股悄无声息的狂潮席卷了我们的人民。其起源何处已经无从追索，但是他们——不，是我们——某种观念已经开始渗入了我们的内心，认定我们[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]一族命中注定应该完成某个更加伟大的事业。我们应该调查是什么造成了这样的“群体性癔症”——耳边响起承诺将统治星河的低声细语的癔症。

研究这类特殊项目将推动我们通往星海天罚之路的进展。
texts.en:
A quiet mania sweeps through our population. Its origin seems intangible, but they - we - have become preoccupied with the notion that we [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are destined for greater things. We should investigate the cause of this mass hysteria, and its whispered promises of galactic domination.

Researching Special Projects like this one will progress us further along the path of Galactic Nemesis.

# 星海天罚 / Galactic Nemesis

- 分类 Category: 天灾（玩家天灾路线）Crisis (player crisis path) · DLC: 天灾降临 Nemesis · 来源 Sources: `events/nemesis_crisis_events.txt`, `events/nemesis_crisis_endgame.txt`, `common/crisis_levels/00_crisis_levels.txt:16-223`, `common/special_projects/00_projects_nemesis.txt`, `common/megastructures/12_crisis_sphere.txt`, `common/resolutions/01_resolutions_nemesis.txt` · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-12 (c5b-crisis)

> 审阅者导读（评注），不是游戏原文。 / Reviewer commentary, not game text.

## 如何开始 How it starts

选择“星海天罚”飞升天赋（ap_become_the_crisis）后进入天灾路线，第一级解锁即收到“宇宙为之颤抖”（4140），开启“化身天灾”事件链与第一项特殊项目。天灾货币为“威胁度”。
Taking the Galactic Nemesis perk; level 1 sends *The Universe Shall Tremble* and the first special project.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. **四项研究与五个等级（严格依次）**：每一级开启一项按帝国类型区分的特殊项目（灵能 / 机械 / 虚境铸就 / 蜂巢 / 一般，互斥）；完成项目并累积威胁度（1000、2000、5000、10000）才能升到下一级，升级3天后收到该级事件（4145、4150、4155）。项目报告依次为“鸿景”“力量之井”“来自异界的燃料”“终焉将临”。
2. **第五级**：离开联邦与共同体；共同体（或银河帝国）被迫通过“宣告危机”决议——你收到 4105/4106，其他玩家收到 4100/4101；若日后被废止，另有 4111/4113 与 4110/4112。5天后“以太相引擎”（6000）在首都星系（游牧帝国为锚站）奠基，再5天得到两艘吞星者（6001）。
3. **吞星**：第一次吞噬恒星时，其他玩家按情报收到三种通报之一（6180/6181/6182）；若毁灭的星系有圣地，圣地守护者震怒（planet_destruction.610，可能引发堕落帝国苏醒）。
4. **引擎建造**（每阶段基础3600天）：第一阶段完工（6005，灵能/同类玩家收到“灵能冲击”）→ 第二阶段（6006，全银河警报；180–660天后虚境生物出现 6151）→ 第三阶段（6007；180–660天后第二波 6161；60–1320天后灵能脉冲 6171）→ 最终完工。
5. **结局**：“始与终”（6050）获胜；1天后其他玩家收到“末日”（6051），所有星系被摧毁。若引擎被毁或星系被占领，建造者/摧毁者/其他玩家分别收到 6101/6102/6103；他国夺取引擎时（6200）可选择摧毁，或在自己也是第五级天灾且失去引擎时接手。

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 胜利：6050。挫败：6101（引擎成为废墟，可再升级重建）。
- 互斥：各级项目按帝国类型；宣告者为共同体或帝国；首颗恒星通报三选一；引擎被毁的三种视角。

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 几乎所有正文按灵能、机械（含虚境铸就起源）、蜂巢与一般帝国区分；游牧帝国在第五级与引擎地点上另有文本与条件。
- “宣告危机”也可被投票用于任何嗜杀帝国，巨兽之怒第五级同样强制通过（见巨兽之怒档案）。

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked: 两个事件文件全部可见事件、等级定义与项目旗标、引擎各阶段的 on_build_complete（12_crisis_sphere.txt:60-182）、宣告/废止决议（01_resolutions_nemesis.txt:55-91, 330-341, 455-461, 617-628）、吞星 on_action（01_planet_destruction.txt:110）。
- 更正 Corrections: 原起点误为“宣告星系危机”（4100，他国视角）；改为第一级 4140，并把 nemesis_crisis_endgame.txt 并入本族（原有8个以太相引擎小故事 event-crisis-6000/6005/6006/6007/6050/6099/6200/6205 现均归入此处）；修正 6101 原挂在夺取事件下的错误（它发给建造者）；移除最终摧毁星系误连到肃正协议的连接。
- 不确定 Uncertain: 4100/4105 亦用于对其他嗜杀帝国或大可汗的决议；引擎工期修正未建模。
- 覆盖范围 Coverage: 61 篇，全部审阅。
